csvjson.label.csv: CSV — the first row is the column names
csvjson.status.idle: Commas and line breaks inside quotes survive intact.
csvjson.err.tooShort: It needs at least a header row and one data row.
csvjson.err.notArray: It has to be an array of objects. e.g. [{"name":"Alice"}]
csvjson.sample.csv:
name,age,note
Alice,30,"a value, with a comma"
Bob,25,ordinary
